title: When Federal Express Staff Were Asked to Hold Their Pay Cheques
conflicts: Losses disagree: nearly $13.4m in two years (Entrepreneur 2008), $27m in two years (Academy of Achievement), $29m in three years (CBS 2023); all three given with attribution, plus PBS's 26 months at a loss. Capital raised: $80m (Entrepreneur) against about $90m (PBS) and $91m (Gale, Achievement caption); story gives $80m and 'nearer $90m'. First night: 186 packages in written sources, 189 in Smith's 2023 recollection; both given. 1976 $3.6m is profit (Entrepreneur) or sales (Gale); profit used.
notes: The Las Vegas blackjack story is attributed to Smith's own telling; the stake ($5,000) and use of the winnings (fuel or payroll) vary across retellings and are left out. Episode dated 1974 (the crisis year) rather than the slate's 1973 launch. The 1974-75 forged loan-guarantee case and acquittal is omitted because no loadable source covered it. Quote stance: complicates.
